changeSet.comment: Seed Trino-compatible flowerbiz business-object detail templates.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template (template_code, domain, role_hint, intent_patterns, question_samples, sql_template, parameters, target_view, description, priority, is_active) VALUES ('TPL-55', 'flowerbiz', NULL, '[".*(\\d{4}年\\d{1,2}月|\\d{4}-\\d{2}).*(报花单据|报花单|报花业务单).*(查|查询|看|查看|列表|明细|清单)?.*",".*(报花单据|报花单|报花业务单).*(\\d{4}年\\d{1,2}月|\\d{4}-\\d{2}).*(查|查询|看|查看|列表|明细|清单)?.*"]', '["2026年3月的报花单据查下","查询2026-03报花单据"]', $tpl$ SELECT CAST(f.id AS VARCHAR) AS "报花单ID", f.code AS "报花单号", f.title AS "标题", f.biz_type AS "业务类型code", CASE f.biz_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 5 THEN '售花' WHEN 6 THEN '赠花' WHEN 7 THEN '坏账' WHEN 8 THEN '内购' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE CAST(f.biz_type AS VARCHAR) END AS "业务类型", f.project_name AS "项目点", f.customer_name AS "客户", f.curing_user_name AS "养护人", f.project_manage_name AS "项目经理", f.apply_use_name AS "发起人", f.apply_time AS "申请时间", f.create_time AS "创建时间", f.finish_time AS "完成时间", f.status AS "状态code", CASE f.status WHEN -1 THEN '作废' WHEN 1 THEN '待发起' WHEN 2 THEN '待审批' WHEN 3 THEN '待鉴定' WHEN 4 THEN '待分配' WHEN 5 THEN '待采购' WHEN 6 THEN '待配送' WHEN 7 THEN '待提花' WHEN 8 THEN '已完成' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE CAST(f.status AS VARCHAR) END AS "状态", f.print_status AS "打印状态" FROM mysql.rs_cloud_flower.t_flower_biz_info f WHERE (f.del_flag IS NULL OR f.del_flag = '0') AND f.create_time >= CAST(:month || '-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND f.create_time < CAST(:month || '-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' MONTH ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT 100 $tpl$, '{"month":{"type":"string","required":true}}', 'mysql.rs_cloud_flower.t_flower_biz_info', '某月报花单据明细（业务对象）', 55, true) ON CONFLICT (template_code) DO UPDATE SET domain = EXCLUDED.domain, role_hint = EXCLUDED.role_hint, intent_patterns = EXCLUDED.intent_patterns, question_samples = EXCLUDED.question_samples, sql_template = EXCLUDED.sql_template, parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, target_view = EXCLUDED.target_view, description = EXCLUDED.description, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = NOW();
